title: Questions 151-152 refer to the following e-mail.
passage_1:
To:Emeka Okafor <e.okafor@postbox.com>
From:Camille Delacroix <c.delacroix@northgatesurveyors.org>
Date:2 February
Subject:Your Membership

Dear Mr. Okafor,

We have received your request to end your membership of the Northgate Institute of Surveyors. As you have been with us for more than eight years, we are very sorry to be losing you.

Before we process your cancelation, we would like to offer you a special deal. If you decide to maintain your membership, we will upgrade your account to the Fellow plan at no extra cost for the next 12 months. That plan gives access to our technical library and to our recorded lecture archive.

If you would like to take up this offer, please write to us by 20 February. Otherwise, your membership will close on 28 February.

Best regards,

Camille Delacroix
Membership Manager
